test.title: Learning history through a board game

paragraphs.text: A secondary school in Leeds replaced some of its history lessons with a board game in which students play the leaders of rival medieval towns. Each turn, they must decide whether to spend money on walls, markets or food supplies.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: After one term, students who had played the game scored slightly higher on a history test than those taught in the usual way. The biggest difference was in questions that asked them to explain the causes of events rather than recall dates.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Teachers noted that quieter students often took a more active part in the game than in class discussions. However, some lessons ran over time, and teachers found it difficult to cover the whole syllabus.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The school now uses the game for 6 lessons a year instead of the original 12, and it has shared the rules with 40 other schools that want to try the approach. Teachers at those schools will report their results at the end of the year.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: students play the leaders of rival medieval towns
items.prompt: In the game, students act as leaders of rival medieval 1 ____.

explanation.en: “the leaders of rival medieval towns” → towns, plural. “Markets” and “walls” are what money is spent on.
explanation.kk: «the leaders of rival medieval towns» → towns, көпше түрде. «Markets» пен «walls» — ақша жұмсалатын нәрселер.
explanation.ru: «the leaders of rival medieval towns» → towns, во множественном числе. «Markets» и «walls» — то, на что тратят деньги.

items.quote: questions that asked them to explain the causes of events rather than recall dates
items.prompt: Players did best on questions about the 2 ____ of events.

explanation.en: “explain the causes of events rather than recall dates” → causes. “Dates” is the contrast, not the answer.
explanation.kk: «explain the causes of events rather than recall dates» → causes. «Dates» — жауап емес, қарама-қарсы ұғым.
explanation.ru: «explain the causes of events rather than recall dates» → causes. «Dates» — противоположность, а не ответ.

items.quote: quieter students often took a more active part in the game
items.prompt: Teachers noticed that 3 ____ students took a more active part during the game.

explanation.en: “quieter students often took a more active part in the game” → quieter. Keep the comparative form.
explanation.kk: «quieter students often took a more active part in the game» → quieter. Салыстырмалы шырай — мәтіндегідей.
explanation.ru: «quieter students often took a more active part in the game» → quieter. Форма сравнительной степени — как в тексте.

items.quote: teachers found it difficult to cover the whole syllabus
items.prompt: Teachers found it hard to cover the whole 4 ____.

explanation.en: “difficult to cover the whole syllabus” → syllabus. Check the spelling: a misspelt word scores zero.
explanation.kk: «difficult to cover the whole syllabus» → syllabus. Емлесіне назар аударыңыз: сөздегі қате есептелмейді.
explanation.ru: «difficult to cover the whole syllabus» → syllabus. Проверьте написание: ошибка в слове не засчитывается.

items.quote: The school now uses the game for 6 lessons a year instead of the original 12
items.prompt: The school now uses the game for 5 ____ lessons a year.

explanation.en: “now uses the game for 6 lessons a year instead of the original 12” → 6. 12 was the original number, and 40 is schools.
explanation.kk: «now uses the game for 6 lessons a year instead of the original 12» → 6. 12 — бұрынғы сан, 40 — мектептер саны.
explanation.ru: «now uses the game for 6 lessons a year instead of the original 12» → 6. 12 — прежнее число, 40 — число школ.
